description: This file defines the EventHubAdapterFactory class, which implements interfaces for queue adapter creation, cache management, and receiver management for integrating Azure Event Hubs with Orleans streaming framework. It includes initialization logic, methods for creating receivers and message batches, and configuration handling.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing EventHub queue adapters, including connection setup, receiver creation, messaging, and caching within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the adapter factory, including setting up event hub client and default handlers.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns the queue adapter instance, initializing queue IDs and stream mapping.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache implementation associated with this adapter.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the current stream queue mapper object.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Provides a failure handler for a given queue ID.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Queues a batch of events for a specific stream, sending data to Event Hubs.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specific queue ID.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache for a specific queue ID.
